Description: A gift in thanks from a Wood Elf for help against the Worm Cult. And help redeeming herself.

A blade used to unite lovers, not separate them.

Place: The Tale of the Green Lady
Item Name: A souvenir of the Shrine of the Green Lady, the most sacred site in Deepwoods.

The edge is so finely honed, it can cut through paper along its width.
